# Mod reference

What a Phase 1 mod can change, generated from the game's own catalog definitions so it matches the game version it came with. The getting-started guide is the template's README.

## Things a mod can add

| Catalog | What |
|---|---|
| [`applications`](applications.md) | One application of a research field: what the player picks when the field completes |
| [`armor`](armor.md) | An armour tier, unlocked by an application (`app`). |
| [`buildings`](buildings.md) | A colony building |
| [`computers`](computers.md) | A battle computer tier, unlocked by an application (`app`). |
| [`race-picks`](race-picks.md) | A race pick: a trait level or a special ability, made of race effects. |
| [`races`](races.md) | A playable race: picks, government, homeworld, AI personality tables, text keys and art |
| [`shields`](shields.md) | A shield tier, unlocked by an application (`app`) |
| [`specials`](specials.md) | A ship special system, unlocked by an application (`app`) |
| [`tech-fields`](tech-fields.md) | A research field: one step of one of the eight research areas |
| [`weapons`](weapons.md) | A ship weapon |
